30.t: Mechanical Counter Continued... There are five coin slots: the LEFT coin slot, the RIGHT coin slot, the CENTER coin slot, the EXTRA coin slot, and the BILL VALIDATOR. The multiplier for each of the these slots determines how many times the mechanical counter is strobed for each coin or bill through the slot. There are two mechanical counter outputs to choose from: mechanical counter output 0 (left side), and mechanical counter output 1 (right side). The default, most commonly used setting is referred to as the “totalizer mode”, and assigns all five slots to counter output 0.
